Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the quick demo last week — the team at Aegis found the latency/cost profile compelling. We need to run a rapid end-to-end SOC2 readiness evaluation against Redwood to validate controls and performance for our procurement committee. Our sandbox expired last week and procurement is asking for a short window to complete the evaluation before the next board meeting (target: July 22).

Can Redwood temporarily reactivate the trial sandbox or provide a short-term credit allocation (~200k tokens, roughly $3k) strictly for the security/compliance evaluation? We can provide the attached vendor questionnaire and SOC artifacts for review. If you need a PO or an addendum, procurement can sign a short-term agreement — we just need the environment unlocked to complete tests.

Key constraints:
- Access for 3 engineers (IP allowlist available)
- No production traffic, evaluation-only
- Time window: 7 days (preferably July 15–22)

Appreciate any expedited help here — procurement deadline is tight.

Thanks,
Jordan Mills
Head of Security
Aegis Health
security@aegishealth.com

Jordan — thanks for the quick turnaround on the questionnaire. Per Marcus and Ops, we can provide a timeboxed evaluation credit window with the following steps (please read and acknowledge):

1) DocuSign addendum — we sent a short addendum via DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.com/secure-link/ah-5021-addendum). Please sign to accept the EVAL-only terms.
2) Credit window — upon receipt of the signed addendum we will provision $3,000 in safety-net credits for 7 days (2025-07-15 through 2025-07-22) scoped to an evaluation tenant.
3) IP allowlist & users — please reply with the three engineer emails and the IPs to allow. Access will be restricted to these identities.
4) Artifacts — thank you for the vendor questionnaire. If available, please upload any SOC2 attestation to the Drive link we shared; we received the questionnaire and have SOC2_attestation.pdf here for your review.

Notes and constraints: credits are for evaluation only and will be revoked if production traffic is observed. Finance confirmed this can be treated as a courtesy one-off; if Aegis converts within 30 days we will roll the credit into the first invoice.

Next step: Jordan — sign the addendum and send engineer emails/IPs and we'll enable access within 2 business hours of receiving the signed document.

Best,
